physical: Gibbs free energy is enthalpy minus temperature times entropy; at fixed temperature and pressure a process is spontaneous when it lowers the free energy. G = H − T × S
reflected_formula: unmatched energy-form = unmatched energy-form − unmatched condition × Culmination
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps: one unmatched energy-form is another unmatched energy-form minus an unmatched condition times Culmination, and a process still runs when the first form falls.
rule_reason: Definition, and the cost block is empty. Definitions keep. Entropy maps to Culmination and does not carry resistance; temperature, enthalpy, free energy, and pressure do not carry resistance either.
interpretation: Culmination stays in the product, and the definition keeps. The fall that lets a process run is not turned into receptivity. Conscious energy and Movement are not in this definition.
closing: The rule decided on its own. It is a definition with an empty cost block, so it keeps, including the clause that a process runs when free energy falls. I did not promote that clause into a resistance-cost the record does not list. Entropy's provisional map to Culmination is used and not treated as opposition.
